title: Emperor Palpatine
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Once known as Senator Sheev Palpatine, representing the planet of Naboo, the future Emperor manipulated his way through crisis after crisis until he was able to seize absolute power, establish the Empire, and destroy the Jedi Order. He revealed himself to be the Sith Lord Darth Sidious and sought to consolidate power by luring the rebels into a final trap and attempting to turn Luke Skywalker to the dark side.
